editorial:
Imagine you are heading home for winter break with a classmate you barely know. You are stuck in a car together on a cold, empty road when suddenly everything goes wrong. That is exactly how this story starts. You get to follow two students who find themselves trapped in a nightmare where the road seems to repeat itself. The vibe is very creepy and lonely, making you feel like there is no way out. It starts as a simple road trip but quickly turns into a fight for survival against spirits who cannot move on from their own deaths.

The acting is surprisingly good and makes the panic feel real. You will love how the mystery unfolds, though some parts might feel a bit slow before the big scares hit. If you like stories with a bit of a puzzle, you should definitely check this out. It looks great if you can find it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but renting it on Apple TV is also a quick way to watch. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the best way to keep this hidden gem forever.
endingExplained: You find out that the road is a loop of death. The ghosts are people who died in accidents there, and they try to kill the living to take their place. In the end, the main character manages to outsmart the spirits. She breaks the cycle by refusing to give in to the fear and chaos. She finally escapes the loop and makes it back to the real world, leaving the ghosts behind in the cold.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves supernatural mysteries and cold, winter settings.
